statement: Pinned hid-playstation requests firmware feature 0xA3/49 bytes with CRC disabled and reads HW version bytes 35–36 and firmware 41–42, but a failed read only warns and leaves sysfs version fields invalid: it does not abort DS4 probe.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 2121–2145, 2791–2795. Thus a synthetic 0xA3 stub is not a must-pass probe gate for this kernel revision.
